notes.title: Welcome to the Wastelands! 🏜️
notes.content:
I’m beyond excited to announce my new game, Dustbound, a unique blend of deckbuilding and bullet-heaven chaos. In this game, you’ll scavenge the remnants of a distant planet whose once-thriving civilization has long since crumbled. Explore mystical ruins, uncover ancient artifacts, and use them to craft your survival strategy.

Build your deck, command customizable drones, and face relentless waves of raiders and monsters. Adapt your playstyle with powerful cards, synergize augments, and harness the dice mechanic to shape your deck into something truly unstoppable.

Prepare for intense battles, fast-paced runs, and endless possibilities. The wastelands are waiting—will you rise to the challenge?

👉 Wishlist on Steam

👉 Try the Prototype on Itch.io https://nordm4n.itch.io/dustboundprototype

A playtest with more features and fixes will follow!

notes.title: Introducing Flexible Autofire
notes.content: Added a flexible autofire system: Hold Left Mouse Button to manually aim or release the mouse button to autofire automatically.

notes.title: Launch Day: Last Star is Here! 🚀✨
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45111080/dc8b4d4e726ce2d7e2c6a6da997f9b1ad3c854d5.png[/img]


Greetings Pilots!

The wait is over—Last Star is now available on Steam! 🚀 Take to the stars in this thrilling retro-inspired shoot 'em up where survival is only half the battle. Choose from 4 unique playable ships, each with distinct abilities, and customize your playstyle with over 60 powerful upgrades.

Prepare to defend the last remnants of humanity against relentless waves of enemies while mastering a fresh twist on the genre with tower-defense-inspired mechanics.

Your journey to save the galaxy begins today. Are you ready to shine as the Last Star? 🌟

🎮 Play Now on Steam!
